decode_layout: 4 bytes required. offset 0..4 = u32 little-endian raw_n. The single argument n:u32 = raw_n % 64 (0..=63), clamping work to the FROZEN sizing attributes (heap_size=32768, max_trace_length=65536); upstream host drives n=50, so 0..=63 covers the intended range. Input shorter than 4 bytes returns an empty Vec (decode is total, no panic). Output = 16 bytes, u128 little-endian.
